description: This Java source file defines the 'PolicyCreated' event class in the Eclipse Ditto project, which models an event emitted after a policy entity is created. It includes methods for constructing instances from parameters or JSON, retrieving the associated policy, and serializing the event to JSON.

classes.name: PolicyCreated
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the creation of a policy, including serialization/deserialization and accessor methods.

methods.name: of

methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a PolicyCreated event.

methods.description: Returns the Policy associated with this event.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the entity (policy) according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
